svg.aria-label: The accepted race between a promotion and a removal of the same member. O1's swap puts M in the chain and O1 sends the commit, while a remover who has not seen the promotion sends a removal of M. A party that applies the removal first refuses the commit but takes M as an owner at its next link read. A party that applies the commit first refuses an admin's later removal, and applies an owner's, taking M back at its next read. If M's own device applies the removal, it leaves for good, and M stays listed as an owner without a device until an owner removes it.

g.text: 6 · The accepted race: a promotion and a removal of the same member
The link decides who is listed as an owner. Which message a party applies first decides its state until its next read,
except that a member device that left stays gone, and relays that applied the removal first have no connection to M [§4.8].

Accepted on 2026-10-19 as a rare edge case, with nothing done for it [Ov: Decisions, §4.17]. A member that leaves while being promoted
ends the same way. A promoter that applied the removal before its swap refuses to add M: CLCAddOwner refuses a removed or
departed member [§4.4]. The commit-first owner-remover cells follow today's checkRole, which the plan keeps; no plan
text or test states them (T8 covers the removal-first order).
